# A planning card keeps the old person's name after the People store is edited

## Context

The Workstation planning arrangement shows a resource's name in the Scheduler and an avatar for that person on the Board. Both consume the root provider's People store.

## The Problem

With the real `BoardPane`, `People` and `WorkItems` classes, the card for a work item assigned to Maya Chen rendered avatar text `MC` and title `Maya Chen`. Writing `people.get('maya').name = 'Zara Vale'` left both values unchanged in that card’s VDOM. Invoking its ordinary `renderItems()` produced `ZV` and `Zara Vale`. This was a single-thread component probe. The corresponding painted-window check belongs in the repair.

## The Architectural Reality

[`BoardPane#afterSetPeople`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/0cc7e43087/apps/workstation/view/BoardPane.mjs#L67) repaints cards on replacement of the People store. The footer renderer reads the name from that store when the work-item card renders. A person edit changes a different record; the work item itself emits no change.

## The Fix

Follow the borrowed People's data changes for the visible cards that depend on the person. Use the store's normal lifecycle so data replacement and batched edits work. Keep destruction ownership with the provider and retire old subscriptions when the binding changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An in-place rename and a batched rename each update the affected displayed avatar's title and initials without an unrelated work-item edit. A second person's card retains its own name.
- [ ] Replacing or removing the person clears stale text. After replacing the People store, an edit to the previous store cannot repaint the board. Destroying the pane releases listeners and leaves the borrowed store alive.
- [ ] A browser witness uses a normal data edit and observes the painted card. The unit control preserves the stale-render case and the positive rerender result.

## Out of Scope

Adding a people editor to the demo or introducing a general-purpose cross-window notification channel.

## Related

Predecessor #20884; shared planning demo #21915. Live latest-open + closed sweep: reviewed the newest 24 Engine issues plus Workstation/people/avatar/rename and BoardPane searches. #21142 covers the examples slate. The open Gantt and Board store lanes do not repair this borrowed lookup.

setup({neoConfig:{unitTestMode:true,allowVdomUpdatesInTests:false,useDomApiRenderer:false},
    appConfig:{name:'BoardPeopleProbe',isMounted:()=>true,vnodeInitialising:false}});
const people = Neo.create(People), store = Neo.create(WorkItems),
      board = Neo.create(BoardPane, {appName:'BoardPeopleProbe', people, store}),
      card = board.getCard('wi-1');
function avatar() {
    const nodes = [], walk = node => {if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;
        if (node.cls?.includes('neo-board-card-avatar')) nodes.push({title:node.title,text:node.text});
        for (const child of node.cn || []) walk(child)};
    walk(card.vdom); return nodes
}
try {
    console.log('record', store.get('wi-1').resourceId, people.get('maya').name);
    console.log('before', JSON.stringify(avatar()));
    people.get('maya').name = 'Zara Vale';
    console.log('after in-place rename', JSON.stringify(avatar()));
    card.renderItems();
    console.log('after ordinary card renderItems', JSON.stringify(avatar()));
} finally {board.destroy(); store.destroy(); people.destroy()}
